This page documents a [[id:699A8D45-B67E-4D3E-9206-24FA17C51ADA][story]] in [[id:2B39B97B-89F9-4320-8BAC-A603D805EBF3][Sprint 26]]. It captures the goal, current status, acceptance criteria, and the tasks that compose it.

* Goal

Each component the clean standard has cleared has a shell surface that generation produces, with every hand-crafted command recorded and justified. The facet's profile-level default split to [[id:8C88DD48-2C49-4DD6-87FB-882FE9E1BCA0][Default the shell facet on at the profile level]] at the sprint 26 close on 2026-10-05.

On 2026-10-05, at the sprint 26 close, this story was reworded to the
surface it delivered and closed DONE. The facet's profile-level default is
[[id:8C88DD48-2C49-4DD6-87FB-882FE9E1BCA0][Default the shell facet on at the
profile level]], and the task Default the shell facet on moved there.

* Acceptance

- Every command the shell answers for each clean component is produced by a generated unit, or is recorded on that component's task as a hand-craft with its reason.
- No two shell units register the same menu or verb, and every duplicate found is removed rather than shadowed.
- The tree builds with every shell suite green.

* Notes

- Survey on 2026-10-01 at =aa08875ec2=: the seven clean components hold 241 shell
  units on disk, all generated. The hand-written surface in their orbit is six
  units, and the whole question of this story is what each of the six is for.
- The facet is opt-in in three places at once: the node =ores.cpp.shell-command=
  carries =#+default: disabled=, eight variability profiles fix it true, and many
  models repeat =:ores.cpp.shell-command.enabled: true= in their own drawer. The
  last task removes the repetition rather than the capability.

* Decisions

- 2026-10-01. One rule decided every component, and it is stated here so the next
  component does not have to rediscover it. A hand-written read is retired when a
  generated unit sends the same request and the hand-written one adds only a
  filter over a field the model already carries. It stays, with a reason, when it
  presents a shape or a request no model states: it changes this client's own
  session, it dispatches a workflow and waits on it, it composes several
  responses into a view, or it moves a file. Eighteen hand-written commands were
  retired across dq, synthetic and iam under this rule, and the rest were signed
  off verb by verb.
- 2026-10-01. The generated unit is the surface even where the hand-written
  command read better. The generated commands print JSON, the retired ones
  printed aligned rows, and the manual and the provisioning recipes moved with
  the names rather than the other way round. The presentation gap is the
  generator's to close, not a reason to keep two commands for one request.
- 2026-10-01. The profile-level default is the last lever and it stays unpulled.
  The facet node's default is global, so enabling it renders a unit for every
  model of every component: 76 models in 16 components at the measurement, 67 of
  them with no profile at all. The story records the precondition rather than
  reaching into sixteen components, most of which it does not own.
